e.title: reservr
e.summary: 删失/截断分布拟合（CRAN 0.0.3）：区间删失/截断数据分布+神经网络拟合——索赔进展/报告延迟建模
e.summary_en: Censored/truncated distribution fitting (CRAN 0.0.3): fit distributions and NNs to interval-censored/truncated data — claims development/reporting delay modelling
e.summary_hk: 刪失/截斷分佈擬合（CRAN 0.0.3）：區間刪失/截斷數據分佈+神經網絡擬合——索賠進展/報告延遲建模
e.body: reservr（CRAN 0.0.3）定义分布族并拟合区间删失（interval-censored）与区间截断（interval-truncated）数据：截断界可依赖个体观测；分布含密度/概率/抽样/拟合方法；log-density/log-probability 的 TensorFlow 高效实现支持参数化神经网络——明确应用于非寿险索赔进展（报告延迟建模）。对 RIAA：删失数据的现代拟合——[[insurance-nowcast]]（burning-cost 报告延迟 ML-EM）的分布拟合层；区间删失（索赔在窗口内发生）是精算数据常态；NN+分布参数化（报告延迟的深度学习建模）；与 [[chainladder]]、[[stochastic-reserving-england]] 配套；适合准备金/报告延迟研究方向。
e.body_en: reservr (CRAN 0.0.3) defines distribution families and fits them to interval-censored and interval-truncated data: truncation bounds may depend on individual observations; distributions feature density/probability/sampling/fitting methods; efficient TensorFlow log-density/log-probability implementations support parametric neural networks — explicitly applied to claims development in non-life insurance (reporting delay modelling). For RIAA: modern fitting for censored data — the distribution-fitting layer of [[insurance-nowcast]] (burning-cost reporting-delay ML-EM); interval censoring (claims occurring within windows) is the norm in actuarial data; NN+distribution parameterisation (deep learning of reporting delays); pairs with [[chainladder]] and [[stochastic-reserving-england]]; suits reserving/reporting-delay research.
e.body_hk: reservr（CRAN 0.0.3）定義分佈族並擬合區間刪失（interval-censored）與區間截斷（interval-truncated）數據：截斷界可依賴個體觀測；分佈含密度/概率/抽樣/擬合方法；log-density/log-probability 的 TensorFlow 高效實現支持參數化神經網絡——明確應用於非壽險索賠進展（報告延遲建模）。對 RIAA：刪失數據的現代擬合——[[insurance-nowcast]]（burning-cost 報告延遲 ML-EM）的分佈擬合層；區間刪失（索賠在窗口內發生）是精算數據常態；NN+分佈參數化（報告延遲的深度學習建模）；與 [[chainladder]]、[[stochastic-reserving-england]] 配套；適合準備金/報告延遲研究方向。
